findings.finding: Label projection first attempts numeric columnar execution, then falls back to projection scan.
Numeric columnar preparation requires predicate via predicate?; the diagnostic full-row READ has no predicate, so this shortcut cannot consume that shape.
Borrowed path additionally requires resident scan, no predicate, same-variable simple projections, no work limit, and admitted pointer estimate; runtime borrowed-row counter remains necessary.
SortExec is separately dispatched with its child input; source reading alone does not establish the actual selected plan or per-stage sort cost.

decision: Do not infer optimization exercise or benefit before actual CI preflight plans, borrowed-row counts and full measurements.
